review_candidates.title: Senior Staff - AI DC Infra Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Introduction We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we are collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar commerce industry from the ground up and establishing an unparalleled reputation for being leading and reliable force in South Korean commerce. We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day. Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world. Role Overview As the Senior Staff AI Data Center Infra Engineer, you will bridge the gap between traditional data center architecture and the specialized requirements of AI/ML ecosystems. This includes deep expertise in High-Performance Computing (HPC), GPU acceleration, high-bandwidth/low-latency networking, and advanced thermal management strategies such as liquid and immersion cooling. You will also serve as a cross-functional engineer, collaborating closely with AI core networking, storage service, AI Compute Platform, hardware vendors, and global operations teams to translate complex computational requirements into innovative, high-density infrastructure solutions. Responsibilities: 1) AI Data Center Strategy & Design: Develop comprehensive architectural roadmaps and blueprints for AI-optimized data centers, considering current and future AI/ML compute, storage, and networking demands. Design physical and logical layouts of data center infrastructure, including racks, power distribution, cooling systems (e.g., liquid cooling), and cabling, specifically for high-density AI hardware (GPUs, AI accelerators). 2) Performance & Scalability Optimization: Design and implement high-performance storage solutions optimized for AI data pipelines (e.g., parallel file systems, object storage, distributed databases). Continuously analyze and optimize data center performance, power utilization, and cooling efficiency to maximize AI workload throughput and minimize operational costs. 3) Power, Cooling, and Efficiency: Lead the design and implementation of advanced power infrastructure to support high-density AI racks and ensure reliable power delivery. Design and oversee the deployment of innovative cooling solutions (e.g., direct-to-chip liquid cooling, immersion cooling) to manage extreme heat generated by AI hardware. 4) Automation & MLOps Integration: Architect automation frameworks for data center operations, including provisioning, deployment, monitoring, and remediation, leveraging AI-driven tools where appropriate. Collaborate with MLOps teams to integrate data center infrastructure seamlessly into the end-to-end AI lifecycle, from data ingestion to model deployment and monitoring. 5) Vendor and Stakeholder Collaboration: Serve as a subject matter expert and technical liaison with hardware vendors, colocation providers, and other external partners. Work closely with internal teams, including AI/ML research, engineering, and operations, to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions. 6) Innovation and Industry Trends: Stay at the forefront of data center technologies, AI hardware advancements, and industry best practices. Research and recommend new technologies and approaches to enhance our AI data center capabilities. Qualifications: * Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Center Management, or related technical field. * Experience: 10+ years of experience in data center architecture, design, deployments and operations. 5+ years of direct experience designing and implementing infrastructure specifically for AI/ML or HPC workloads. Proven track record of delivering large-scale, high-density data center solutions. Extensive experience with various data center cooling technologies (CRAC/CRAH, liquid cooling, immersion cooling). Hands-on experience with server hardware, particularly GPU servers and AI accelerators. * Technical Skills: Deep understanding of data center power distribution, electrical systems, and UPS/PDU technologies. Experience Deploying large scale NVIDIA GPU systems – Air Cooled and Liquid Cooled Knowledge of various storage technologies and their suitability for AI/ML workloads (e.g., NVMeoF, parallel file systems, object storage). Familiarity with cloud computing concepts and hybrid cloud architectures. Understanding of containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) in a data center context. Proficiency in scripting or programming languages (e.g., Python) for automation. Knowledge of data center monitoring tools (DCIM) and practices. * Soft Skills: Exceptional problem-solving and analytical abilities, with a strong attention to detail. Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of explaining complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. Collaborative mindset, adept at working with cross-functional teams and external partners. Strategic thinker with the ability to plan for future technological needs and scaling requirements. Proactive, self-motivated, and passionate about the intersection of AI and data center technology. Preferred Qualifications: Experience Deploying large scale NVIDIA GPU systems – Liquid Cooled Industry certifications related to data centers (e.g., CDCP, CDCS, Accredited Tier Designer, Accredited Operations Specialist) or cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Experience with CFD tools (6sigma, Tileflow) from an infrastructure perspective. Familiarity with data center automation platforms and DCIM (Data Center Infrastructure Management) tools. Experience with green computing initiatives and sustainable data center design. Recruitment Process and Others Recruitment Process Application Review - 1st Interview - 2nd Interview - Offer The exact nature of the recruitment process may vary according to the specific job and may be changed due to scheduling or other circumstances. Interview schedules and the results will be informed to the applicant via the e-mail address submitted at the application stage. Details to Consider This job posting may be closed prior to the stated end date for application if all openings are filled. Coupang has the right to rescind an offer of employment if a candidate is found to have submitted false information as part of the application process. Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran’s benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws. Job titles and responsibilities may be subject to change depending on the candidate’s overall experience, etc. This will be communicated to the candidate at the appropriate time before the offer. Hiring may be restricted in case the legal qualifications required for hiring and work performance is not met. This is a full-time regular position and includes 12 weeks of probation period; provided, however, the probationary period may be either skipped, shortened or extended if necessary for business purposes Privacy Notice Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below. https://privacy.coupang.com/en/land/jobs/ Document Return Policy This notification is given pursuant to Article 11 (6) of the Fair Hiring Procedure Act. A job applicant, who has applied but not been finally selected for a position at Coupang (the “Company”), may request the Company to return his/her hiring documents submitted pursuant to the Fair Hiring Procedure Act. However, this will not apply where the hiring documents were submitted via the website of the Company or e-mail, or where the job applicant submitted those documents voluntarily without a request from the Company. In addition, if the hiring documents were destroyed due to a natural disaster or any other reasons not attributable to the Company, such documents will be deemed to have been returned to the job applicant. A job applicant who wishes to request the return of his/her hiring documents pursuant to the main sentence of paragraph 2 above should fill out a “Request for Return of Hiring Documents” [Annex Form No. 3 in the Enforcement Rule of the Fair Hiring Procedure Act] and submit It by email (recruitingops@coupang.com). In such case, within fourteen (14) days from the date of identifying the receipt of the request, the Company will send the hiring documents to the job applicant’s designated address via registered mail. Please be informed that the job applicant is required to pay the postage on the registered mail. In preparation for a job applicant’s request for the return of hiring documents pursuant to the main sentence of paragraph 2 above, the Company shall retain the original hiring documents submitted by the job applicant for 180 days from the completion of the recruiting process. If no request is made until the end of this period, all his/her hiring documents will be destroyed immediately in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act. The above paragraphs 1 - 4 shall only apply when the labor-related laws of Korea govern the application. They are otherwise not applicable.
